sources.description: Current public portfolio data in src/Data and the structured knowledge modules.
The owner-provided 95-question personal knowledge profile. Each record keeps its own status and access classification.
Structured personal knowledge base; use as supplemental context and honor its verification caveats.

sourcePrecedence: Owner-provided Q&A with its stated status

statusDefinitions.VERIFIED: Supported by current portfolio or documentary data in the project.
statusDefinitions.USER_REPORTED: Present in information supplied by Rabea; not independently verified.
statusDefinitions.HISTORICAL: Was recorded previously and may no longer be current.
statusDefinitions.UNCONFIRMED: Conflicting or insufficient information; explain uncertainty.
statusDefinitions.INFERRED: An assessment from the available facts, not a confirmed personal claim.
statusDefinitions.OUTDATED: Superseded by a newer explicit fact.
statusDefinitions.PLANNED: A goal or plan, not a completed achievement.

privacy.policy: Private records are never sent to the visitor client or retrieved into the public assistant prompt.
privacy.visitorContact: Only public professional channels in knowledge/contact.ts may be shared.

conflicts.portfolioDescription: The current project page describes ATHAR as an Arabic web platform.
conflicts.supplementalDescription: The owner-provided Q&A describes a React Native / Expo / Firebase mobile app.
conflicts.resolution: Do not combine the two stacks or claim they are the same product. Tell visitors the source descriptions differ until Rabea confirms.
Use Business Information Systems (BIS); older MIS wording is outdated.
Use the AWS Certified Developer – Associate certificate record in src/Data/certificates.js.

updateHistory.change: Added the owner-provided 95-question FAQ corpus, access/status labels, privacy redaction, and lightweight retrieval metadata.
